title: Headless engine vs UI client split
text:
Symptom / ask: Media/transcode concerns leak into the UI repo (or UI into the engine).
Cause: Unclear ownership between headless service and client.
Do: Keep filesystem/transcode/security in the engine; keep browse/watchlist/player UX in the client; speak a narrow authenticated API.
Don't: Grow a second media stack inside the UI 'for convenience'.
Pointer: paired service + frontend systems.
